summary: Azitra, Inc. filed an 8-K on July 15, 2026, announcing positive ex vivo results for its ATR-COSF program, a cosmetic ingredient using a recombinant filaggrin domain in a supernatant. The press release details improved distribution and anti-wrinkle effects in human skin models. No transaction, deal terms, or corporate event is disclosed; the filing solely reports product development milestones. As a routine operational update, this does not constitute a special situation under standard categorization criteria.
